text:
liz: proposal: a tiny "who changed" pill on routing policy pages. shows actor, time, short diff + export button :eyes:
omar: sounds good. need API + quotas. api idea: GET /v1/audit/policy/{id}/latest for panel, POST /v1/audit/exports for full exports
neha: PII rules: UI shows human display names, exports obey tenant redaction_mode (raw|pseudonymize|redact) :lock:
ui-ux: interaction: pill -> small panel with 3 rows (actor, when, short diff) and "Export" CTA. fast path should be <200ms
liz: implementation: materialize latest per-policy on writes, serve from redis for <50ms. full audit stream still append-only
omar: export semantics: NDJSON bundle + separate manifest with actor_resolution_trace, redaction_mode, requester, ts
neha: manifest must flag any PII truncation and include KMS key id used for envelope encryption
platform-bot: queued export job id=e702, est size=8MB, presigned link expires in 7d
liz: quota plan: preview cache (last 24h) cheap quota, full exports consume tenant export quota. show cost estimate in panel before export :money_with_wings:
omar: API example for docs: POST /v1/audit/exports {filters:{policy_id:"pol_123",since:"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z"},redaction_mode:"pseudonymize",reason:"debugging routing"}
ui-ux: UX copy: manifest link text = "Download audit bundle (includes actor manifest)"
neha: telemetry: events = audit.ui.view, audit.export.request, audit.export.complete. Do not include resolved names when redaction_mode != raw (send pseudonymized ids instead)
liz: rollout: internal 2w -> opt-in Dedicated customers -> GA. RFC incoming with endpoints, manifest schema, quota rules, and rollout plan
compliance-bot: reminder: exports older than 90d require approval and justification field (max 100 chars)
platform-bot: export size soft limit 50GB; automatic chunking >10GB
liz: thanks all. I'll draft RFC and link mockups once ui-ux shares them.
